description: Header file for nedmalloc, an alternative thread-safe memory allocator implementation based on dlmalloc. Defines functions, macros, and structures for custom memory management, including pool management and optional namespace control.

methods.name: nedblksize
methods.description: Returns the usable size of an allocated memory block.

methods.name: nedsetvalue
methods.description: Sets a value associated with the allocator or pool.

methods.name: nedmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size.

methods.name: nedcalloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for an array.

methods.name: nedrealloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory to a new size.

methods.name: nedfree
methods.description: Frees allocated memory.

methods.name: nedmemalign
methods.description: Allocates memory with specified alignment.

methods.name: nedmallinfo
methods.description: Returns memory allocation info (if enabled).

methods.name: nedmallopt
methods.description: Adjusts memory allocator parameters.

methods.name: nedmalloc_trim
methods.description: Trims unused memory from the allocator.

methods.name: nedmalloc_stats
methods.description: Prints allocator statistics.

methods.name: nedmalloc_footprint
methods.description: Returns the current memory footprint.

methods.name: nedindependent_calloc
methods.description: Allocates multiple objects independently.

methods.name: nedindependent_comalloc
methods.description: Allocates multiple objects with specified sizes.

methods.name: nedcreatepool
methods.description: Creates a memory pool for custom allocations.

methods.name: neddestroypool
methods.description: Destroys a previously created memory pool.

methods.name: nedpsetvalue
methods.description: Associates a value with a memory pool.

methods.name: nedgetvalue
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a memory pool or memory block.

methods.name: neddisablethreadcache
methods.description: Disables thread cache for the calling thread.

methods.name: nedpmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory from a specific pool.

methods.name: nedpcalloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory from a pool.

methods.name: nedprealloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory within a pool.

methods.name: nedpfree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated from a pool.

methods.name: nedpmemalign
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory from a pool.

methods.name: nedpmallinfo
methods.description: Returns memory info for a pool.

methods.name: nedpmallopt
methods.description: Adjusts parameters for a pool.

methods.name: nedpindependent_calloc
methods.description: Independently allocates multiple objects in a pool.

methods.name: nedpindependent_comalloc
methods.description: Independently allocates multiple objects with specified sizes in a pool.
